limitations: Fixed alpha, beta, v>0; stiffness tends to infinity; no thermal noise; no uniform estimates as rates vary or full stationary law.
scientific_integrity: The exact asymptotic is proved for a six-state finite-tumble jamming model; finite checks do not certify the infinite limit. The original generator and model are credited to Hahn. No full invariant density is claimed.
title: Sharp contact-mass loss under strong harmonic binding with finite run-and-tumble duration
